headline: Western Washington ends Concordia Irvine's season
dek: The defeat left no PACWEST program with a match still to play, closing the season for the conference's highest-scoring side. Concordia Irvine finished with thirteen wins, five draws, and three losses in all matches, scoring 41 goals, more than any of the other nine programs, while conceding twenty.
displaced_by: Concordia Irvine lost to Western Washington, ending the conference's season and giving Concordia Irvine a third defeat
